paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 4.28 as of September 29, with a 0.47 percent increase from the prior close and a 13.88 percent decrease over the last 21 sessions. There have been 3 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include Fermi bringing on NAES to run Project Matador Gas Fleet, Project Matador advancing toward first power with the NAES operating deal, and an article questioning whether Fermi is undervalued following the NAES deal and Project Matador progress. These articles were published by Hart Energy, Construction Review, and simplywall.st on September 29.

There have been 25 total filings, including 3 form 4 filings, and 7 proxy solicitation filings. Recent filings include a PX14A6G form filed on September 11, a form 3 filed on September 3, and an 8-K form filed on August 31, which announced the scheduling of the company's first annual meeting of stockholders.
